text: Lesson 135.
The latest report.
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
zh: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
zh_hant: 聽錄音，然後回答這個問題。

text: Is Karen Marsh going to retire, do you think?
zh: 你觉得卡伦·马什真的打算退休吗？
zh_hant: 你覺得卡倫·馬什真的打算退休嗎？

text: Are you really going to retire, Miss Marsh?
zh: 马什小姐，你真的要退休吗？
zh_hant: 馬什小姐，你真的要退休嗎？

text: I may.
I can't make up my mind.
I will have to ask my future husband.
He won't let me make another film.
zh: 他不会让我再拍电影了。
zh_hant: 他不會讓我再拍電影了。

text: Your future husband, Miss Marsh?
Yes.
Let me introduce him to you.
His name is Carlos.
We're going to get married next week.
zh: 我们下星期就要结婚了。
zh_hant: 我們下星期就要結婚了。

text: Look, Liz!
Here's another report about Karen Marsh.
zh: 这里又有一篇关于卡伦·马什的报道。
zh_hant: 這裡又有一篇關於卡倫·馬什的報道。

text: Listen: 'Karen Marsh: The latest.
zh: 听着：‘卡伦·马什：最新消息。
zh_hant: 聽著：‘卡倫·馬什：最新訊息。

text: At her London Hotel today Miss
zh: 今天在伦敦的酒店里，马什小姐
zh_hant: 今天在倫敦的酒店裡，馬什小姐

text: Marsh told reporters
she might retire.
She said she couldn't make up her mind.
She said she would have to ask her future husband.
zh: 她说她得问问她的未婚夫。
zh_hant: 她說她得問問她的未婚夫。

text: She said her future husband
would not let her make another film.
Then she introduced us to Carlos
zh: 然后她把卡洛斯介绍给我们
zh_hant: 然後她把卡洛斯介紹給我們

text: and told us they would get married next week.'
zh: 并告诉我们他们下星期就要结婚。’
zh_hant: 並告訴我們他們下星期就要結婚。’

text: That's sensational news, isn't it, Kate?
zh: 这可是爆炸性新闻，是吧，凯特？
zh_hant: 這可是爆炸性新聞，是吧，凱特？

text: It certainly is.
He'll be her sixth husband!
zh: 他将是她的第六任丈夫！
zh_hant: 他將是她的第六任丈夫！
